item.title: Complaining About The Few Staff Left Is Just Lazy
item.description: Read Complaining About The Few Staff Left Is Just Lazy Regular: "I've been coming here since 1995, and I used to be helped all the time. Y'all used to bag for me, too! Now I have to do everything myself. The quality of the service has really gone down. You're one of the good ones, but the new generation… so lazy!" Read Complaining About The Few Staff Left Is Just Lazy

item.title: 21 Penny Dreadfuls
item.description: Read 21 Penny Dreadfuls She immediately starts going on about her missing 21p. Me: "Okay, I can refund it to your card without needing the register. Is that alright?" Customer: "How dare you be so disrespectful! Cash! Cash! This store is awful!" Read 21 Penny Dreadfuls

item.title: So, No Breathing At Work? Got It!
item.description: Read So, No Breathing At Work? Got It! Unfortunately, I had an asthma attack while working the register. I hadn’t had one in ages, so I didn’t have my inhaler. Emergency services end up having to be called, and I am taken to the hospital When I got back to work a couple of days later, I got called in to the office. Manager: "Sign that." Read So, No Breathing At Work? Got It!

item.title: Need A New Mart Cart? Urine Luck!
item.description: Read Need A New Mart Cart? Urine Luck! I look at her and… a smell suddenly hits me. She smells like she hasn't showered in weeks. She has crumbs and grease all down her clothes. Read Need A New Mart Cart? Urine Luck!

item.title: Wait Until They Find The Pain
item.description: Read Wait Until They Find The Pain I work in a restaurant on the French Riviera, so we get a lot of tourists. A group of English-speaking diners has been given our menu, which is French for the first half and English for the second. Read Wait Until They Find The Pain
